dedupe_keys.name: multi class road surface condition dataset for pothole and road damage classification bangladesh

description: This Mendeley Data deposit holds 7,489 RGB image crops, cut from 3,154 road photographs taken in Bangladesh from Google Earth imagery and smartphone cameras, for classifying pothole and road damage automatically. The images are 224 by 224 pixels and fall into six classes: cracks (1,689), damaged asphalt (1,830), open manholes (126), potholes (1,324), water-filled potholes (1,272) and clean background (1,248). Kona Moni, Tanvir Ahmed and colleagues at United International University, Dhaka, published it on 12 August 2026 under CC BY 4.0, free to download. Coverage is Bangladesh without a stated list of roads, and the file formats are not described on the page read. Caveats: the images are crops, not full scenes, labels are single class per crop and the mix of satellite and phone images may bias models. For simulation, it supports road condition modelling, capacity planning and asset management studies and machine vision training. Related catalogue record: data-bdroad-sense-bangladesh-road-surface-images, another Bangladesh road surface image set.
